At this time, we expect that sales will continue to be good in FY 27 and FY 28.
The Company employed 7.82% women employees in FY 2025-26 vis- à-vis 7.57% in FY 2024-25.
Growth & demand: HBL achieved 100% growth in sales in our Data Center businessover the previous year.
HBL witnessed ~15% growth despite logistics disruptions towards the year-end due to the West Asia conflict.
HBL has invested about Rs 200 crores for R&D and a modern production plant adequate for foreseeable demand.
